title: Enforce exact DAO option framing before origin replay classification
description: P1 protocol/security: spec/05-routing.md §8.6 requires structural option framing (including Transit Data Length exactly 20 and unknown/malformed options) to reject before key lookup/signature/replay. Production DaoOriginValidator only checks the final signature option and classifies replay, then DaoManager parses route options afterward. TransitInformation.from_option() additionally accepts length >=20 with the parent flag and silently ignores trailing authenticated bytes (and accepts non-profile short/no-parent forms), so a signed noncanonical DAO can install a route. Add one detached exact-wire structural pass before origin verification/replay, require the profile's exact Target/Transit lengths and permitted flags/options, and run malformed+lower-sequence ordering vectors against production.
